card.name: Digits inside years in China texts
card.fires_on: The middle digit of a four-digit year (like 19x5 or 20x7) in text about China, its history or politics. Also fires on a comma after a Chinese platform name such as Twitter equivalent.

modes.description: A digit partway through a year in passages on Chinese history, politics or literature.
